profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software developer with full-stack web development experience. Strong in JavaScript and PHP, with additional experience in Python, HTML, and CSS. Background in software testing and development, with a focus on building applications in agile environments. Currently pursuing an associate’s degree in Cybersecurity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build, maintain, and fix back-end and client-side features for web applications using PHP and JavaScript (Laravel, Slim PHP, Svelte) 
Collaborated with the technical lead on architecture and design for a new web application
Conduct code reviews to ensure best practices, maintainability, and secure coding standards  
Collaborate with development team and project managers to align software with business goals

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Build, maintain, and fix back-end and client-side features for web applications using PHP and JavaScript (Laravel, Slim PHP, React, Svelte)  
Lead application security efforts, identifying and mitigating risks based on OWASP Top 10 (2021)  
Conduct code reviews to ensure best practices, maintainability, and secure coding standards  
Collaborate with development team and project managers to align software with business goals
positions.insights: Relational Databases, Web Application Development and +10 skills

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Build, maintain, and fix back-end and client-side features for a product information management system using Laravel and Vue.js  
Researched and integrated new packages and technologies, optimizing system performance and ensuring long-term maintainability.
Write documentation  to support onboarding and knowledge transfer
Write unit tests for software reliability
positions.insights: Relational Databases, Web Application Development and +7 skills

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
Build, maintain, and fix back-end and client-side features for web applications using Slim PHP, Aurelia, and React  
Implement cloud-based solutions using AWS services (S3, EC2, RDS)  
Deliver new features and enhancements aligned with business requirements  
Collaborate in an agile Scrum team to meet sprint goals and deadlines
positions.insights: Relational Databases, Web Application Development and +9 skills

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Analyst
positions.description:
Performed manual and automated testing for web applications to ensure functionality, reliability, and alignment with requirements  
Assisted building and maintaining automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver and executed performance testing with JMeter  
Developed and updated test cases to cover new and existing features, supporting software quality and stability  
Collaborated with developers to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve bugs
